description:
One thesis in full with its discussion: body, stance, author, the author's
    position, reactions and the replies (oldest first). Use after another csid_
    tool when the user wants to read a thread. cursor pages through the replies.

    Needs your own CabalSpy API key with a CabalSpy ID instance (no demo).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor taken from the previous response. Leave empty for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

instance.description: Your CabalSpy ID instance (its client_id, e.g. 'csid_1a2b…'). Only needed when your account has several instances. Leave empty otherwise.
instance.title: Instance

replies_limit.description: How many replies to include (0-50, default 20).
replies_limit.title: Replies Limit

thesis_id.description: Thesis id (UUID) from another csid_ tool, e.g. '7d4436ac-c0ef-4655-995f-10b06af94f21'.
thesis_id.title: Thesis Id

name: csid_thesis
